GH_SDMtune

2026-08-20

library(pacman)
## Warning: package 'pacman' was built under R version 4.5.3
p_load(SDMtune,
       tidyverse, 
       terra, 
       sf, 
       ENMeval,
       ggplot2,
       tidyterra,
       gt,
       ecospat
)

Set seed for reproducibility

set.seed(15) #set random seed in order to reproduce this analysis

Read in presence and environmental data

occ_train <- read.csv("ENM_inputs_final/gh_occs_train_05_24.csv")
occ_test <- read.csv("ENM_inputs_final/gh_occs_test_05_24.csv")

envs <- rast("ENM_inputs_final/gh_envs_05_24.tif")

bg <- read.csv("ENM_inputs_final/gh_bg_05_24.csv")

bg <- bg %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X)
# Create SWD object
train_data <- prepareSWD(species = "Yellow Fever",
                   p = occ_train,
                   a = bg,
                   env = envs)
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for presence locations✔ Extracting predictor information for presence locations [183ms]
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations✔ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations [427ms]
test_data <- prepareSWD(species = "Yellow Fever",
                   p = occ_test,
                   a = bg,
                   env = envs)
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for presence locations✔ Extracting predictor information for presence locations [147ms]
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations✔ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations [237ms]

Create cross-validation folds

cb_folds <- get.checkerboard(occ_train, envs, bg, aggregation.factor = c(8,8))
## Generating hierarchical checkerboard partitions...
table(cb_folds$occs.grp)
## 
##  1  2  3  4 
## 26 21 28 22
table(cb_folds$bg.grp)
## 
##    1    2    3    4 
## 2518 2455 2556 2471

Run maxent model with optimal tuning arguments

# Train a Maxnet model
model <- train(method = "Maxnet", 
               data = train_data, 
               folds = cb_folds,
               reg =  0.5,
               fc = "l")
## Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                  50% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:01Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:1.6
model
## 
## ── Object of class: <SDMmodelCV> ──
## 
## Method: Maxnet
## 
## ── Hyperparameters 
## • fc: "l"
## • reg: 0.5
## 
## ── Info 
## • Species: Yellow Fever
## • Replicates: 4
## • Total presence locations: 97
## • Total absence locations: 10000
## 
## ── Variables 
## • Continuous: "mean_temp_coldest_quarter", "precip_wettest_quarter",
## "NDVI_mean", "elevation", "built_surface", and "edge_density"
## • Categorical: NA
map <- predict(model, # CV model, average of folds
        data = envs,
        fun = "mean",
        type = "cloglog")
## Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■                           20% | ETA:  5s - 00:00:1.3Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■                     40% | ETA:  3s - 00:00:1.9Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■               60% | ETA:  2s - 00:00:2.3Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         80% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:2.7Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:2.8
plot(map)

Variable importance

vi_maxnet <- SDMtune::varImp(model, 
                    permut = 100)
## Variable importance  ■■■                                8% | ETA: 15s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■                             12% | ETA: 14s - 00:00:02Variable importance  ■■■■■■                            17% | ETA: 13s - 00:00:2…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■                           21% | ETA: 12s - 00:00:3…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■                         25% | ETA: 11s - 00:00:3…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■                        29% | ETA: 10s - 00:00:4…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■                       33% | ETA: 10s - 00:00:05Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■                      38% | ETA: 10s - 00:00:5…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■                     42% | ETA:  9s - 00:00:6…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                   46% | ETA:  8s - 00:00:07Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                  50% | ETA:  8s - 00:00:7…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                 54% | ETA:  7s - 00:00:8…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■               58% | ETA:  6s - 00:00:8…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■              62% | ETA:  6s - 00:00:9…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■             67% | ETA:  5s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■            71% | ETA:  5s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■           75% | ETA:  4s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         79% | ETA:  3s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■        83% | ETA:  3s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■       88% | ETA:  2s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■     92% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:14Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■    96% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:1…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:1…
vi_maxnet <- vi_maxnet %>% 
  mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable == "built_surface" ~ "Built surface area",
    Variable == "edge_density" ~ "Edge density",
    Variable == "mean_temp_coldest_quarter" ~ "Mean temperature of coldest quarter",
    Variable == "precip_wettest_quarter" ~ "Precipitation of wettest quarter",
    Variable == "NDVI_mean" ~ "NDVI",
    Variable == "elevation" ~ "Elevation",
    TRUE ~ Variable
  ))

vi_maxnet_tbl <- vi_maxnet %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  cols_label(
    Variable = "Covariate",
    Permutation_importance = "Permutation importance (%)",
    sd = "Standard deviation (%)"
  ) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Permutation_importance", "sd"),
    decimals = 2
  )

vi_maxnet_tbl

tiff("Final_Results/variable_importance.tif", width = 180, height = 120, units = "mm", res = 300, compression = "lzw")

Plot standard deviation of environmental suitability

sd_map <- predict(model,
        data = envs,
        fun = "sd",
        type = "cloglog")
## Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■                     40% | ETA:  2s - 00:00:1.2Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         80% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:2.2Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:2.3
summary(sd_map)
## Warning: [summary] used a sample

##  1st Qu.:0.018  
##  Median :0.029  
##  Mean   :0.036  
##  3rd Qu.:0.045

plot(sd_map)

sd_map_final <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = sd_map) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(fill = "Environmental Suitability\nStandard Deviation")+
  theme_bw() + #Clean theme
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # Remove minor grid lines
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), # Remove axis ticks,
    axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text (coordinate degrees)
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

sd_map_final

ggsave(
filename = file.path("Final_Results/GH_SD_suitability_map.tiff"),
plot = sd_map_final,
device = "tiff",
dpi = 300,
width = 180,
height = 120,
units = "mm",
compression = "lzw"

compare with Lim et. al 2025

# import Lim et. al raster of YF suitability

#5×5km spatial-resolution global maps of probability of occurrence
# occ data from 1927-2024
# 105 occ from 2015-2024
lim <- rast("Sensitivity Analyses/YF_riskmap_wmean_masked.tif")

plot(lim)

Check sensitivity and CBI values based on Lim et. al 2025 yellow fever suitability map

coords_test <- test_data@coords[test_data@pa == 1, ]
coords_train <- train_data@coords[train_data@pa == 1, ]

# crop and align to Ghana template
lim_ghana <- lim %>% 
  terra::crop(ext(map)) %>% 
  terra::resample(map, method = "bilinear") %>% 
  terra::mask(map)

plot(lim_ghana) 
points(coords_test, col = "red")

res(lim_ghana)
## [1] 0.008983153 0.008983153
lim_test_suitability <- terra::extract(lim_ghana, coords_test, 
                                       search_radius = 2000) 
# 2 test occurrences were on edge of Lim raster -- increase search radius to pull 
# suitability from nearest valid cells

# Lim binary threshold
lim_thr <- 0.32

lim_sens <- mean(lim_test_suitability[, 2] >= lim_thr, na.rm = TRUE)
lim_sens 
## [1] 1
summary(lim_test_suitability$YF_riskmap_wmean_masked, na.rm = TRUE)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##  0.4772  0.7376  0.8106  0.8144  0.9219  0.9933
bg_vals <- terra::values(lim_ghana, na.rm = TRUE)
test_vals <- lim_test_suitability[,2]

lim_train_suitability <- terra::extract(lim_ghana, coords_train, 
                                       search_radius = 2000) 
train_vals <- lim_train_suitability[,2]
train_vals
